description: Search open senior roles (Manager to C-suite) at the 500 largest US companies by words, seniority band, function, work mode, region, city or state, minimum salary and recency. Returns up to 25 roles a page with title, level, location, posted pay range, date and a link. Use it for "VP finance roles in Texas", "remote director of engineering jobs", "what CFO roles are open". Limitation: no company names; the role page shows them to members.

band.description: Seniority: csuite, svp, vp, director, manager.

function.description: Job functions, e.g. Finance, Technology. Call list_filters for the full list.

location.description: A city or a US state, by name or code, e.g. Chicago, Texas, TX.

posted_within_days.description: Only roles first seen in the last N days.

q.description: Words to search titles, e.g. "CFO" or "VP supply chain".

region.description: us = United States only, intl = outside the US.

sort.description: senior (default), newest, or comp (highest pay first).

status.description: open (default), new (7 days), today (24 hours), filled (last 30 days).

name: search_roles
title: Search senior roles
